title: Offline KSU fan compatibility input, schema 1
description: A caller-supplied compatibility declaration, not device or kernel-loadability proof. No ready-to-use manifest, KO or installer is supplied. The builder enforces this contract with Python stdlib checks; this schema is for input tooling and is not fetched or executed. SHA-256 values use lowercase hexadecimal. Source project.json and project.py audit-apk remain the authority for APK signing identity/package/version.

target_kernel_release.description: Exact target uname release, not a substring match. Locally asserted, not read from a device by this builder.

expected_vermagic.description: Exact .modinfo vermagic including any trailing space; tokens must include modversions. Production requires its first token to equal target_kernel_release. Only explicit first-control commissioning may retain distinct exact OEM uname and module vermagic identities, and then a hash-bound commissioning vermagic_release_review is mandatory. The helper embedded manifest still must independently match both strings and all CRC/hash identities.

expected_symbol_crcs.description: Exact target MODVERSIONS CRC inventory, including module_layout. The builder compares every classic 64-byte __versions record, all undefined imports and this inventory. Expected CRC provenance must be checked by the caller and covered by the local reports.

hardware.description: Exact caller-supplied target properties bound to the local record. No live-device checks are made here. The reviewed installer must independently enforce target compatibility before mutation.

name.description: For additive: eta_fan_policy or another exact standalone name, never oplus_fan. For explicit preinit-replace: exactly oplus_fan, packaged only at preinit/bin/oplus_fan.replacement (not a second insmod payload).

templates.description: Exact inventory and SHA-256 of all files in the explicit reviewed template directory. Only these text files and their necessary directories are allowed; symlinks, extra files, no-op scripts and placeholder markers are refused. No templates are generated or inferred. module.prop must contain exactly id/name/version/versionCode/author/description, id=horae_fan_spoof, name=风扇控制, description=风扇控制与状态显示。 and current audited App version/versionCode. updater-script is #MAGISK plus LF. Shell semantics, the non-charging 29.5 C rule, charging non-interference and install/uninstall correctness are the caller's review responsibility, not established by this offline builder. Only preinit-replace additionally requires preinit/preinit.conf, with exact bytes exec bin/fan-preinit --apply plus LF and no other actions. No additional files or executable payloads are allowed under preinit; helper and replacement are explicit separate inputs. The current helper reports apply success with code 10, while KSU nonzero exec handling requires lifecycle coordination; this builder does not force script text to translate that return code. Only the explicit commissioning_profile=first-control channel additionally requires fg-debug.sh and allow-control; both are forbidden in additive and ordinary release. allow-control must be exactly first-control plus LF, is non-executable, and is hash-bound like every template. fg-debug.sh retains the same reviewed shell/shebang/no-second-load checks.

strategy.description: Omitted retains the original additive profile exactly. OEM replacement requires the explicit preinit-replace strategy; no automatic profile inference.

helper_enabled_manifest_digest.description: SHA-256 of the exact bytes of the explicit --helper-enabled-manifest JSON file, whose fields follow $defs.helperEnabledManifest. This is a mirror of the immutable C manifest, not a true/verified flag. The builder parses the helper ELF fan_release_manifest read-only symbol and compares every field with this JSON and the KO/kernel/version-section identities.

preinit.description: Allowed only for explicit preinit-replace. Helper is supplied separately via --preinit-helper, never copied from templates. ELF64 LE AArch64 ET_EXEC, no INTERP/DYNAMIC/NEEDED; unstripped fan_release_manifest object must be read-only and enabled. Default disabled DEV helper is refused. ZIP helper/replacement share preinit/bin/. Entire preinit subtree must total strictly less than 4 MiB. Installer must separately check at least 8 MiB free in metadata; this builder does NOT verify device space, first-load timing, mounts, successful loading or return-code integration.

commissioning_profile.description: Only with --commissioning-record and --confirm-first-control, never a production release. Requires preinit-replace and both first-control template files. No implicit installation or reboot.

helperEnabledManifest.description: Separate --helper-enabled-manifest JSON input, not an installed runtime config or an authentication record. Values mirror struct fan_manifest in the supplied helper. SHA/size bind the replacement bytes, versions_sha256 hashes raw __versions section bytes, versions_count counts its classic 64-byte entries. kernel_release/vermagic must match compatibility; KMI is derived with the existing helper release parser. Every field is compared against the actual read-only 72-byte ELF fan_release_manifest object. Integer present=1 alone cannot enable a disabled binary. Unstripped named symbol is deliberately required; unsupported ABI/layout is refused.
